title: Minimum Reverse Operations
problemStatement: You are given: An integer n A starting index p A list of banned indices An integer k Initially, a token is placed at index p. In one operation, you may reverse any contiguous subarray of length k containing the token. The token moves to its new position after the reversal. Determine the minimum number of operations required to reach every index. Return -1 for unreachable indices or banned indices.
input: Integer n Integer p Integer b Array banned Integer k
output: An array of length n where the i-th element is the minimum number of operations required to reach index i.
